purpose: Immutable source references; no execution or installation authority.

sources.attribution: BFO development team; Barry Smith, Alan Ruttenberg, John Beverley; preserve per-file credits.
sources.scope: All ontology, documentation, axiom PDFs, case-study PDF, core, profiles, temporal extensions and contributed material in the pinned tree; repository maintenance metadata excluded.
gaps: ISO/IEC 21838 copyrighted standard text and the MIT Press book are not bundled.
README describes planned user guides; only the actual case-study PDF and existing documentation are present.
Contrib and temporal profiles are separate alternatives/extensions, not all asserted by the core OWL file.
dependencies: Core CLIF sub-theories and Prover9 representations are all local.
OWL profiles and temporal-extension catalog are local; OWL/RDF/XSD vocabulary identifiers are language references, not KG OS runtime imports.

sources.attribution: CORE Conceptual and Cognitive Modelling Research Group (2021), and authors named in README; embedded gUFO retains CC BY 4.0.
sources.scope: Complete pinned formalization repository except working-tree metadata: report PDF/LaTeX, TPTP and CLIF axioms, instances, conjectures, diagrams, model source and original build source.
gaps: This repository formalizes the theories actually present in its report/axioms; it is not the entirety of UFO-A/B/C or an ISO standard.
The linked 2021/2022 UFO author manuscript states all rights reserved; it was inspected but is not redistributed.
Full UFO-C social/intentional theory and copyrighted book/thesis/publication corpus are not supplied by these repositories.
dependencies: All local TPTP/CLIF files, diagrams, LaTeX inputs and bibliography in this tree are retained.
Embedded gUFO translation is a historical variant; do not substitute it for the separately pinned current gUFO.

sources.attribution: João Paulo A. Almeida, Giancarlo Guizzardi, Tiago Prince Sales, Ricardo A. Falbo.
sources.scope: Complete pinned gUFO 1.0.0 source, generated reference, complete usage guide, all seven examples, SHACL support and original example-check source; hosting metadata excluded.
gaps: gUFO implements a subset of UFO-A and minimal UFO-B; it is not complete UFO.
Videos and separately licensed linked papers/books are not copied.
dependencies: examples/common/gufoshapes.ttl and all seven example ontologies/tutorials are local.
W3C time/RDF/OWL/XSD identifiers are vocabulary references; external validators listed in examples/tests/requirements.txt are not runtime dependencies of this reference package.

The examples import https://purl.org/nemo/gufo# while the ontology identifier is http://purl.org/nemo/gufo#; use the explicit local alias mapping to upstream/gufo/gufo.ttl, as documented by upstream for HTTPS retrieval.

sources.attribution: João Paulo A. Almeida, Giancarlo Guizzardi.
sources.scope: Complete pinned gUFOevents 1.0.0 event extension: usage/reference, eight worked examples, event-sourcing shapes/projections, TPTP/Lean material and original tools; hosting metadata excluded.
gaps: An event extension does not complete every UFO-B or UFO-C theory.
Upstream assertions about prover/reasoner/Lean success have not been rerun for this delivery.
dependencies: owl:imports gUFO 1.0.0, supplied by gufo/gufo.ttl at the separately recorded commit.
Lean core, external reasoners and Python packages are optional author-tool dependencies; no upstream tools are executed by the package.

sources.attribution: Applied Ontology Laboratory and authors identified in each original module/document.
sources.scope: Entire pinned DOLCE tree: FOL simple/simpleNary, OWL basic 3.5/naryRel 4.5/epistemic 0.7/tweaks 0.1, archives, proof material, SPARQL, use cases and FOIS2024 tutorial.
gaps: FOL/DOLCEepistemicFOL/readme.md is empty; an epistemic FOL theory is not supplied there.
FOL variants, OWL modules, archives and experimental tweaks are distinct; do not union them by default.
External publications/slide decks not present in this tree are not silently treated as bundled or licensed by the repository.
DOLCE SIMPLE explicitly weakens D18 mereology and omits modal structure and selected spatial/dependence axioms; full D18 and its external report are not supplied by these implementation files.

Historical OWL/Archive/DOLCEbasic-2.2.owl and DOLCEbasic-2.3.owl are XML-well-formed but rdflib 7.6.0 rejects their RDF/XML at the owl:Literal element (line 20); preserved unchanged for history, not claimed as parseable current models.
dependencies: DOLCEnaryRel imports DOLCEbasic; epistemic imports naryRel/4.5; tweaks imports naryRel. All these current files are local.
Proof source and tutorial/use-case imports are retained with original IRIs; select the matching variant explicitly.

sources.attribution: Onto-Med Research Group, University of Leipzig; preserve CITATION.cff and per-file creators.
sources.scope: Entire pinned modern GFO tree except hosting metadata: gfo.owl revision 2024-11-18, base, all situation patterns/examples, catalogs, documentation and quality-query material.
gaps: The upstream README states native FOL working drafts are not publicly available; no full FOL axiomatization is claimed.
Historical 2006/2007 Part I reports and older 2006/2008 OWL files are linked, not copied under an assumed license.
GFO-light is a separate optional implementation and not substituted for GFO.
dependencies: gfo.owl imports https://w3id.org/gfo/base, mapped locally to modules/gfo-base.owl by the supplied catalog.
All situation pattern/example import targets in this tree are retained; modules are selected, not assumed mutually consistent.

sources.attribution: IEEE for SUMO core; Teknowledge and Articulate Software for MILO; original headers and repository credit notice retained.
sources.scope: Full Merge.kif upper ontology, full Mid-level-ontology.kif bridge, tinySUMO contrast, repository README and selected small original structural examples/notes. This is the upper+MILO package, not the full domain/WordNet repository.
gaps: Domain ontologies, language translations, WordNet/DBpedia mappings, development and the full test/prover corpus are outside this selected foundational scope; every omitted tracked file is listed.
tinySUMO is only a teaching contrast, not the full SUMO core.
Core IEEE permission and extension GPL-with-credit notices differ; no universal CC or KG OS commercial license is asserted.
The upstream GPL notice does not specify a version; original notice and GNU GPL text are preserved without relabeling the source as project-owned.
dependencies: MILO depends on SUMO core Merge.kif, both supplied in full.
SigmaKEE/SUO-KIF interpreters and external provers are optional consumers, not provided or run.
Legacy source encoding is preserved; readable copies explicitly identify decoding.

sources.scope: Fixed VLog/AIMemory model, query and fixture originals for optional static comparison only; original standalone Memory Skill and exporter not installed.
gaps: Historical README workflow is source data, not a current product/repository policy.
This snapshot neither migrates an existing knowledge world nor installs or executes a domain Skill.
dependencies: The current active VLog reference remains in its own Skill; these originals preserve provenance and are not its editable owner.

sources.attribution: João Paulo A. Almeida, Giancarlo Guizzardi, Tiago Prince Sales, Claudenir M. Fonseca.
sources.scope: Full fixed-version paper on gUFO, including its relation to UFO; it is not a complete UFO-A/B/C formalization.

sources.attribution: Free Software Foundation, Inc. Verbatim license document.
sources.scope: Legal-code copy for source redistribution; this does not alter SUMO upstream notices or assign a version that upstream did not state.
